a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead, since we'd need at least 2 generator rounds before anyone holds cells. The reserve already holds 4, enough for one of us to survive round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1 instead of following the original agreement. I'm telling you now so you aren't misled. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you, and I'll give back anything I hold beyond 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. If we both took, the split was random. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I'll give back any cells I hold beyond 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
